New entries come from the review after a session: the session's own agent declares what it learned, and the code checks the evidence before writing. TSCCModules.flowIntro: How the system prompt is assembled each turn —
TSCCModules.flowIntroTail: The read path only assembles; over-budget warns, never truncates.
TSCCModules.flow1Desc: Set the context-file budget ceiling from the model's context window.
TSCCModules.flow2Desc: Models ≥64K try the full L1_SYSTEM_PROMPTS.md cache: reused only if git status (15s TTL) + budget header match. The desktop main path is cache-safe (the prompt is now a pure function of the on-disk files); only excluded-file sessions bypass to avoid poisoning the shared cache.
TSCCModules.flow3Desc: P0→P9 sequential read, each _clean_content() (strip comments, redundant H1). (PROJECTS.md was removed 2026-08-14.)
TSCCModules.flow4Title: Select MEMORY / EVOLUTION by whole units
TSCCModules.flow4Desc: Every entry in the file is in force; nothing is filtered by a state. Within budget the file goes in whole; over it, whole entries compete by score, meta-cognition first, rendered in file order. An entry not chosen stays in the file and is reached by recall.
TSCCModules.flow5Desc: Pure-filesystem keyword search (allow_embed=False, vector infra off). 5 domains serial, injected with [RECALLED] provenance tags.
TSCCModules.flow6Desc: Sum section tokens incl. ## headers. Over budget → WARNING log, inject full, no truncation (design §3.5). CJK 1.1 tok/char, Latin 2.2 tok/word.
TSCCModules.flow7Desc: Dynamic, session-specific content appended at the tail.
TSCCModules.flow8Desc: Join sections with \n\n → full prompt; metadata stored for this panel (GET /chat/{id}/system-prompt).
TSCCModules.noRecall: No recall ran this session — recall fires once, on the first substantive message (skipped for channels / short openers).
TSCCModules.noMatch: Recall ran but matched nothing — the agent was prompted to grep

TSCCModules.scanNote: Static scan of the assembled prompt · secrets masked · reuses egress credential detectors.
TSCCModules.scanFooter: Design-time scan of assembled context, not a runtime output filter.

TSCCModules.tokenNote: CJK 1.1 tok/char + Latin 2.2 tok/word (calibrated). Read path never hard-cuts; over-budget warns only.
